reviews.text: It would be nice if they had a separate line for on-line order pickups. I had to wait in line for my order. I ordered this way I would be in and out.
Very friendly staff and a variety of products and services for your pets

I went yesterday and  they said they would get a cage from inventory if I purchased by this weekend because they were on sale.  I went today and the manager didn’t want to honor what was stated yesterday even though the employee helping me said i don’t know they said and did that yesterday he just doesn’t want to do it today.  Lost my business today and future.  Poorest customer service I have ever received.  Will not be going back there.
The best of the San Fernando Valley, you can find everything for any type of pet
Everyone is always so nice and helpful here. They always have good deals going on and their variety of animal supplies is great!
Very friendly very clean and they help you on anything u need I asked them what my pet had and right away they showed me what to buy they game me various options
Gively was super knowledgeable and helpful. She’s passionate about animals and it shows.
I love this store; I find what I'm looking for, and above all, the staff are very friendly and always try to help. They take the time to explain what's good for your pet.
The associates were so nice. I always find what I need too.
If youre looking for a higher tier from Petco/Walmart, head here.
Great selection of pet products and the staff is always friendly and helpful.
great place. parking a little cramped. Worth it though. knowledgeable staff.

I have been shopping here since they opened the new store in canoga. Im so disappointed to see them advertising and selling betta fish in bowls as the perfect home. I know I can't expect pet stores to provide perfect care, but seeing them slowly transition to something that's on par with petsmart/co is such a shame. During their anniversary sale I purchased a pacman frog who ended up being incredibly ill. He now is permanently disabled and will require medication for life. I would be very weary of purchasing live animals here if you don't have a good exotic vet to take them to.
Really great selection for pet food. Wish they had more harnesses for cats and dogs and better options for claw trimmers

Huge selection of fish and birds! Everything was clean and well-kept. Lots of exotic species for sale, such as mudskippers and parrotlets. The birds had lots of space and enrichment. Nice and helpful staff.

Been coming to this pet store in Sylmar for quite some years for my dog , snake, tortoise, and bird needs !!! They have everything you need for new and experienced pet owners . I also appreciate the broad knowledge from the employees, great customer service
I love this beautiful little duckling he likes to follow me around and he likes to be in the little pond I have swimming and likes to cuddle with me thank you pet supreme💙🧡 …

Love this place . The staff here are friendly and helpful and the store is clean and fully stocked and neat always . They also have a member day I think the 3rd Saturday of the month where they give you more money off you just have to bring in there bag I guess ? Im not to sure about that because when I went in the first time a guy offered to give me one of his bags to get the discount and so I did and saved 15 dollars I think that day and gave th guy his bag back after leaving the store . I know it exist but I haven't actuelly signed up and looked into it . The prices are good and there are a variety to inexspensive to exspensive foods and they have everything in between.
Thank you for being a place for me to come into !!
My go to place ! In the neighborhood when I need food for my pets . Great service too
A lot of good stuff here for cheaper prices! I love this place!
Excellent service

Excellent customer service. Very nice and kind  people.  All the personnel at the store are very efficient and fast. I'm very satisfied with the service. The store is a little bit pricey compared to other stores, but Pet Supreme is a big store, and you can find everything for your pet. They have a pet clinic and pet grooming, too!
Friendly and helpful customer service. Good discounts!

Ally and Giselle where absolute stars while helping me understand and fixing my issue with one of the purchase benefits I get though the VIP program. Thanks again and congrats to Pet Supreme for 35 years!

Cool employee, lots of choice 👌
I do recommend. I have bought my fishes there …

I am writing this review to praise the customer service I received today.
I called pet supreme today because I needed to get a receipt of purchase, I do not have an account with PS. My job requires a receipt and I completely forgot to get one last week.

Today I called and was helped by a gentleman named Marco(s). I told him my issue and he could’ve said no he couldn’t help and went about his day. Instead, he took the time to help me out, gather some info and later emailed me the receipt. His effort saved me a hassle I would’ve had to deal with at work. I appreciated him going the extra mile for me so I just know he’s a great employee all around.

As far as my visit to pet supreme, everything was stocked with lots of different variety of items and check out was easy.
A big store with all kinds of pet supplies. There's a vet right next door. Friendly service.  Totally handy, for those in the area.
Ok variety of dog food. I would call ahead . Dog wash available
My favorite pet store with great prices and friendly staff!
Staff is friendly.
I went today for the time in about a year and they didn't have half of the animals or inventory they used to have. Maybe I went on a off day.

I think this is the best maw and pop.Type pet shop around. They have everything that you would need for dogs , cats , reptiles , chicks and quails . Small animals , huge section of fresh and salt water fish and more. It's like going to a petting zoo. Thier vet clinic is top of the line and\nIs very affordable. They also donate to pets and animals in need.You cannot find a friendlier staff.Thank you , pet supreme for all you do
Awesome
Gively was extremely professional and helpful

Kept seeing the sign on the Foothill side, and finally made our way in. My family enjoy themselves looking at all the fish and all the small animals, the reptiles, and we bulked up on treats and goodies for the dogs. We also asked for help in regards to our red-eared sliders, and got so much help from a woman in the back. We continue to stop and every other week for Turtle things and things for the dogs.
Supreme pet shop

Called bc I had a fish aquarium emergency and was transferred to their aquatic specialist. I didn’t catch her name but she was incredibly helpful and gave me advice on products to buy to save my water perimeters. Went from + 8.0 ppm ammonia to 0.0 ppm in 3 days. Prices are good and always good variety too. Thanks to the queen that helped me
Love the variety of toys, food and EVERYTHING in there. Better than PetSmart. ❤️

Love coming here for my dogs products and for my reptiles food they have a big selection and majority of the staff nice and helpful expect for the “manager on duty” he has glasses and always makes it seems like he doesn’t like working there… has a bad attitude as well when trying to ask for help. That’s my only complaint I have, wish they hired an actual good manager who cares about the store and its customers.
Staff is very knowledgeable & helpful.
Great selection...puppers loves coming in for treats!
Large selection, helpful staff, reasonable prices.

Great place for pet lovers, I love all the deals and specials sign up for a account to get deals. They have a dog wash station here also. Lots of freshwater fish and aquatic plants, employees have lots of pet knowledge.
Erick was very kind and provided excellent service. He was very friendly and polite, and spoke to people very politely. Thank you so much for the service; I highly recommend it.

Awesome costumer service. Very wide variety of reptiles,birds,fish and aquatic plants I have gotten my son 2 house geckos and a pink toe tarantula from here we always come here for pet supplies the workers are very nice here and are always willing to help the customers 10/10 recommend as a local pet store if it is in your area the parking does suck though there is also a vet and have their own pet washing machine for 15 bucks
This is our goals to store, to buy our Dogs food..Always in stock and great prices!
This place has everything you could need, great selection of aquatic pets huge warehouse style but easy to navigate
I get my bird food here. Nice people, good selection in everything pet related. My local pet supply spot.

Love shopping here for my pets ! Everyone is friendly ! Great team !

Great people  and everything I need for dogs

I bought this dog food here for my dog because it was on sale and I was tryna save money but I regret it . I got home and opened the bag and something was off my dog's got sick when they ate it . I got the same dog food from somewhere else  and my dogs ate it with no problem . DO NOT BUY THIS FOOD FOR YOUR DOG HERE! and I regret not getting a receipt with my purchase so I could get my money back . Shame on you for selling this .
Good local pet store ,good prices, friendly stuff.

Every time I drive by and l live in the neighborhood the fence in back is closed and it appears closed.

Great place for all my pet needs.
Decent dog wash area, lacks brushes to finish the job though, so bring your own.  Also minimal parking.

Great pet store! Really good selection of fish, aquatic plants, and pretty good prices. The girl who helped me actually knew about fish unlike most workers at other places. They actually care and ask you questions about your tank, fish, and setup you have to make sure it works out for you and your fish. Will definitely be back when I'm around the area 10/10 👏🏽
Large selection of products, and good prices.
Great pet store with little pets to buy

Love having a neighborhood super store for pets. They have everything for so.ambtndoffwent types of animals or pets. I do a lot of shopping here for it's huge aquarium and terrarium supplies. I also get most of my dog grooming and treats from here.   They stock a lot of locally made dog treats too so you know they put effort into bringing the best stuff to us.
Whatever you need,  they have it here.
Awesome, local shop! Definitely coming back.
I love this place variable selections and prices. Love it!!

Greatest I've seen for a pet store
Awesome place pretty big very friendly
A place with a wide variety of pet supplies, friendly staff who are always willing to help - they just need to hire more staff to provide better customer service.
Definitely Wheelchair Friendly The aisles are wide enough for a chair.  Throughout the three years that I have been going there, customer service has always been kind and helpful.

This is a great place for all kinds of pet supplies at very reasonable prices. They have many food items you can buy in bulk which is really nice especially if you are trying something new.  The staff is friendly and helpful.  They have everything pet.  Sometimes parking is tricky but not impossible.
They have a great selection of reptiles and food for them.

We love shopping at Pet Supreme! This is our go to store for all our pets' needs. We always buy hay, pellets, and vitamins for our guinea pigs here, along with food and treats for our dogs. They also have a great selection of collars  we love picking those out!

The manager is always so friendly and helpful. No matter what questions I have about our animals, they take the time to answer them and make sure we find exactly what we need. The entire staff is super friendly and welcoming every time we come in. It’s clear they really care about animals and their customers.

Highly recommend this store for all your pet supplies!
Great place with good variety and stocked well. Friendly staff too!

Pet supreme is the best pet store I've been to. I always find what I'm looking for and it has a friendly atmosphere. The staff is polite and always ready to help you. Plus the prices are decent. Can't complain here......

All management on top of it employs on top of it all the animals inside even the aquarium very excellent super clean prices are excellent the best in Los Angeles California . They have also so much knowledge to help out any animal any need
Very expensive.

cool pet store with plants and bird equipment and fishes but the bettas are in tinier jars than the ones in petsmart. It’s not hard to put them in a bigger tank like a 1.6 with heaters and filters. I’m not aware of the policy of this specific pet store though…

We went to get supplies to help us start up our new aquarium, The staff was considerate kind and helpful. And several went above and beyond by assisting me by finding seating and helping me get out of the chairs since I'm currently using a walker after my very recent knee replacement. Getting up out of chairs sometimes it's very difficult and one of the ladies in the dog wash area was very considerate by holding my walker while I stood up. Also when I was getting out of my vehicle one of the forklift drivers noticed I was having some difficulty and offered to help me. My wife who did most of the shopping was helped out a great deal by several people, had her questions answered and assisted her in finding the supply's she needed without having to walk around the store too much. All in all it was a very good experience.
They are very friendly and helpful.
Great place to buy essential pet supplies. Place is somewhat big and have variety of things, great prices, good customer service. Sometimes gets busy and not enough parking space.

There's a lot of variety, but the customer service is terrible; they should pay more attention to that. The new store on Shermanway has excellent service; all the employees are very friendly and attentive, nothing like the Sylmar store.

My family and I love pet supreme! They have some very cute gishes there, some beautiful plants for the fish tanks. Alot  supplys for different types of pets.the staff there are very friendly and helpful. They also sell birds here and snakes.

Pet Supreme is honestly one of my favorite local spots. They’ve got a huge variety of stuff for all kinds of pets whether you have dogs, cats, reptiles, birds, or fish, you’ll find what you need. I always find something new whenever I stop by, and their prices are fair too. The staff is friendly and really seems to care about helping you find the right things for your pets. It’s just a solid, reliable place with a good vibe. Definitely worth checking out if you haven’t yet.
The best the region has to offer for your pets
The BEST pet store in the area. My husky loves when I bring back goodies for him. Definitely check them out for all of your pet supplies.

Horrible service at the Pet Clinic. Dr Fam refuses to do "paperwork" for dog evaluations. Receptionists had me go back twice two days in a row so we can see a Vet - only to tell me that Dr. Fam can't do the paperwork because it's too much "work" to fill out since my dog got attacked by another dog or coyote. "For precaution purposes" he didn't want to deal with my dog! His cuts weren't that bad. (I cleaned them up myself with a bath) All I wanted was a rabies shot for my dog just incase. And Dr. Fam sent us off to Canoga Park facility. Sounds like someone is lazy to me! It's not cool to brush people off, then take the next person in line because that was an easier "less" case to deal with. He wants quick fast money without doing actual hard work. Sucks!! I do not recommend them at all.

I will no longer be purchasing my dogs food or supplies with them, and I encourage others to do the same.
